Stop "Failing Fast"
In my last two gigs, I seem to have been surrounded by C-suite dolts that keep repeating the l*et's fail fast!* mantra as if it's a golden rule in business. First, it's not. And second, at the salaries I'm talking about, you're paid to ***not*** ***fail AT ALL***. Remember your MBA? Your undergrad degree from Michigan? Your time at the Wharton School? Your vast experience in the industry? Your deep wisdom and lessons learned? Your reputation as a keynoter? Your certifications? The admiration of your peers? Your SMART goals? Your StrengthFinder results? Yeah. Those things. That's why you're paid to ***succeed***, toots, not make dumb excuses for why you make terrible decisions with awful P&L impact and mess with people's lives.
